api.setBroken: rig.setBroken({'pw-dome': true}) or rig.state.broken[id] = true; ?broken=id,id|all (short ids dome, fist, valve ok)
api.anchor: rig.anchor(id) returns [x, y, r] in CSS pixels of .stage, following the deformed body
api.stage: stage aspect 1856 x 1412 (painting plus pad 480 x 130)

brokenFlag: each notch is baked into the texture (ember rim, ink cracks, jagged erase) and works in every mood; a broken part also leaks steam
notes: pw-fist is the viewer-left forearm (the punching arm). pw-valve is the round brass valve on the viewer-left leg, the clearest one.
